zaragoza_bunny_depth_error.description: Depth MAE on the Zaragoza Stanford bunny scene from Fig. 5. The paper reports that Quasi-Fresnel achieves the lowest bunny depth error among the compared direct methods.

albedo_psnr_db.description: Albedo PSNR on the same public bunny scene, included to catch methods that preserve depth while degrading the reconstructed appearance emphasized in Fig. 4.

albedo_ssim.description: Albedo SSIM on the same public bunny scene, a structural image-quality check complementary to depth MAE.

zaragoza_efficiency_public_bunny.description: Public Zaragoza efficiency claim from the Results section. The paper reports about 0.17 s runtime and less than 50 MB memory for the proposed method, versus more than 6.39 s runtime and more than 13.105 GB memory for prior volumetric methods.

traditional_runtime_order.description: Empirical log-log runtime scaling slope for the direct Quasi-Fresnel reconstruction path, checking that speed is not achieved only at the benchmark resolution.

loading_memory_order.description: Empirical log-log memory scaling slope for the sequential-loading variant, checking the paper's low-memory complexity claim.

loading_depth_consistency_cm.description: Depth disagreement between the sequential-loading and direct reconstruction paths on the public bunny scene, catching methods whose memory-saving path changes the result.
